result: All executed automated checks passed. One reproduced progression bug fixed locally; static advisories remain. Fix not deployed.

findings.trigger: Restore a different phone-message scene while an incoming message typing indicator is active, then advance the restored scene.
findings.cause: A restored message increments the generation without clearing the previous typing animation; the stale completion cannot reset _animating.
findings.fix: Cancel the previous typing wait and reset _animating at the beginning of MessengerView.present.
findings.regression: tests/e2e/night-messenger.spec.cjs now asserts animation cancellation, no stale typing row, and successful advancement.

findings.fix: Added tests/log-transport-timeout.test.cjs to the default npm test command list.

additionalNodeTests.note: Includes cases not selected by the default runner; overlaps exist with other suites, so counts must not be added as unique coverage.

browser.cleanupNote: After all 350 cases passed, the audit-owned static server was stopped to release delayed runner cleanup. The runner then printed the passing summary and exited with code 0.
browser.note: The full audit started before the fix; the affected specs ran with the fix. A separate focused suite also verified the fix.
